post_clip.description: Mutual combat: two individuals engage in aggressive physical confrontation—both actively throwing punches and grappling (frames 4–7), with one person being pushed to the ground and both maintaining offensive postures. A third person intervenes later (frame 8+), but the initial exchange clearly meets the definition of fighting with mutual aggression.

Multiple individuals engage in mutual combat: a woman in black initiates aggressive movement toward a man near the right wall; shortly after, two men (one in white shirt, one in gray) rush in and join the confrontation, with visible pushing, grabbing, and striking motions. All parties are actively involved in physical aggression—consistent with mutual fighting. A puddle appears on the floor during the altercation, possibly from a knocked-over container or spill during the struggle.
